notes.title: [Update] 90fps + Hand Tracking Improvement + Chinese support
notes.content:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38210973/89ed7837b0fa6d555085041fc88cfbc60a1ccfa8.png

We have good news for Quest 2 users!

Pedro and Rosa's heartwarming story can now be enjoyed with an enhanced experience.
• Quest 2 frame rate and resolution optimizations:
The game now runs at 90fps and 1.3x native resolution on this device.

• The game now uses “High Frequency Hand Tracking” mode on Quest 2, increasing tracking rate to 60hz

• Chinese Interface, subtitles, and Full Audio available

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38210973/c8de32502876698da182c1a96b5a14d0af56a00c.gif

🌻

notes.title: New Languages Update Added!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/nWEXRmE.png

The award-winning interactive love story just got better with brand new language support! Now we have three great narrations and seven supported subtitles to bring the story to more people around the world. Check out the list of languages below:

Current Narration Support

 English 
 Portuguese
 Korean


Current Subtitles Support

 English 
 Portuguese
 Korean
 Spanish
 French
 Japanese
 German
